name: @bruschill/pi-plugin-security-audit
description: Static security audit + tamper-evidence tooling for Pi agent extensions, plugins, and skills. Installs the guard, fingerprint engine, launchd watchdog, and audit/approve scripts into ~/.pi/agent at their fixed integrity-anchored paths.
